in_sanskrit.name: शरविन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: शरदे विजयी, तापसे धीमान (Victorious in Autumn, Shining Bright like a Fire)

in_marathi.name: Sharwin
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharwin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। 1. A name derived from Sanskrit 'Shri' (God) and 'Har' (friend). 2. Signifies being a devout companion of the divine. 3. In Hindu mythology, Sharwin is considered a divine friend to the gods.

in_bengali.name: Sharwin
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's friend
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sharwin একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। 1. A name derived from Sanskrit 'Shri' (God) and 'Har' (friend). 2. Signifies being a devout companion of the divine. 3. In Hindu mythology, Sharwin is considered a divine friend to the gods.
